run_standard_validator: run the StandardValidator to validate a machine learning model during training with eval units and data readers
create_validator_implementation: create a custom Validator subclass implementing run and reset methods for model validation during training
reset_standard_validator: reset the StandardValidator to clear step counters, data readers, and timers for a new validation run
use_noop_validator: use the NOOP_VALIDATOR singleton as a no-op placeholder when model validation is not needed during training
review_standard_validator_init: review the StandardValidator constructor to understand required parameters like units, data readers, gangs, and metric recorder
